known_gaps: The full V14, V8, 16-layer deep explanation, and original FINZANJIR_AI v0.6.0 ZIP have not been fully ingested into this JSON corpus.
This is not the full 4,671-record V317 corpus. Only selected, source-described facts from the V317 audit are included.
Some legacy v3 records do not preserve original section/page/version provenance.
All current records remain candidate_not_authoritative pending source review and owner/expert approval.
Retrieval is lexical and synonym-based, not a fully evaluated semantic/vector search system.
PDF/OCR/table extraction, duplicate/conflict governance UI, authoritative promotion workflow, and retrieval benchmark are not implemented.

privacy_scope.public_kb: Contains project concepts and technical design only; private author biography and personal conversation memory are intentionally excluded.
privacy_scope.user_queries: The v4 AI interface does not persist user questions in its project knowledge database.
privacy_scope.external_provider: Each Gemini Interactions API request sets store=false to disable server-side Interaction storage. The user question and selected knowledge snippets are still transmitted to Google for processing; Google Search grounding may query public web sources. Provider service/security processing remains subject to Google's terms.
